Prizes:

1st place: 30 AMB packs, 6 AMB Black Packs, 6 FTC Gold Packs, 1 MRC Gold Pack,  5 Sapphire Packs,  1 Finalist Playmat, 1 Champion Playmat, 1 National Invite Card

2nd place: 15 AMB packs, 5 Black Event Packs,  5 FTC Gold Packs, 1 MRC Gold Pack, 4 Sapphire Packs, 1 Finalist Playmat, 1 National Invite Card

3rd & 4th place each: 8 AMB packs, 4 Black Event Packs,  4 FTC Gold Packs, 1 MRC Gold Pack, 3 Sapphire Packs, 1 Finalist Playmat, 1 National Invite Card

5th to 8th place each: 6 packs of AMB, 3 Black Event Packs,  3 FTC Gold Packs, 1 MRC Gold Pack,  2 Sapphire Packs, 1 Finalist Playmat, 1 National Invite Cad

All participants
3 AMB packs, 2 ALC packs, 1 SP2 Pack, 1 AMB  Black Pack, 1 FTC Silver Pack, 1 Sapphire Pack, 1 Proxia Vault Pack, 1 Grand Archive Binder

Luck draws will include: 

1 AMB Box
AMB booster packs
1 MRC event Kit
MRC event packs
Promo Idle Thoughts
Grand Archive Premium Deck Boxes
Grand Archive Playmats

And more!!

Please note that players are obliged to play at least 2 rounds before receiving the Grand Archive Binder as participation reward. Those players who registered and played but do not show are not eligible to receive the reward. We reserve the right to pass the reward to a player that showed up and signed up and pay the fees as the tournament starts at 9am.

Do message us at our facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/thecardshopplt or join our Grand Archive whatsapp group at: https://chat.whatsapp.com/HqLGODiJf8nEUyWcp8u0De

Please register yourself at omnidex at https://omni.gatcg.com/events/12998 first before making payment. Please have your omnidex number on hand when communicating payment. Thank you!
